violatedPolicies.name: Container with privilege escalation allowed

violatedPolicies.remediation: Verify that privileged escalation is required and cannot be provided with a subset of other controls. Disable privilege escalation by setting allowPrivilegeEscalation to false.

violatedPolicies.name: Docker CIS 5.15: Ensure that the host's process namespace is not shared
violatedPolicies.description: The Process ID (PID) namespace isolates the process ID space, meaning that processes in different PID namespaces can have the same PID. This creates process level isolation between the containers and the host.
violation: Deployment uses the host's process ID namespace
violatedPolicies.remediation: You should not create a deployment with `hostPID: true`

violatedPolicies.name: Red Hat Package Manager in Image
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with components of the Red Hat/Fedora/CentOS package management system.
violation: Container 'ai-agent' includes component 'dnf' (version 4.14.0-34.el9_8)
Container 'ai-agent' includes component 'rpm' (version 4.16.1.3-40.el9)
Container 'ai-agent' includes component 'yum' (version 4.14.0-34.el9_8)
violatedPolicies.remediation: Run `rpm -e --nodeps $(rpm -qa '*rpm*' '*dnf*' '*libsolv*' '*hawkey*' 'yum*')` in the image build for production containers.
